title: Lovable raises $400M Series C
summary: Lovable, an AI-powered developer platform, has secured $400 million in Series C funding, reaching a valuation of $2.15 billion. The round was led by Accel with participation from existing investors, bringing total funding to over $500 million.
problem_solved: Making application development faster and more accessible through AI-powered tooling
why_valuable: The massive funding round demonstrates strong investor confidence in AI-native development tools and positions Lovable as a leading platform in the competitive no-code/low-code market
